count_definitions.admitted: Rows whose Adapter and returned task identity were verified.
count_definitions.analysis_attempted: Admitted rows for which syntax analysis started.
count_definitions.attempted: Selected rows for which admission loading was attempted.
count_definitions.blocked: Rows not attempted because they were unadmitted or outside the limit.
count_definitions.failed: Selected rows ending in an admission, analysis, timeout, or runtime error.
count_definitions.observed: Analysis completed without error or incomplete tool output.
count_definitions.partial: Analysis returned at least one incomplete tool output and no error.
count_definitions.selected: Review candidates selected within the case limit.

interpretation: Observed means the syntax tools returned without an error. It does not establish correct recovery of data flow, control flow, or Mock dependencies.
